diurnal_seasonal.scope: training receptor rows with interpolation/missing flags excluded

correlations.scope: training receptors, exact t+3h safe labels only

class_distribution.scope: all splits, receptor total and all-node context; descriptive only
class_distribution.risk_definition: Project experimental levels [<15, 15-<35, 35-<55, >=55]; not official hourly AQI.

wind_rose.scope: training only; receptor plots, all-node statistics; calm/flagged hours excluded
wind_rose.interpretation: Calendar SW monsoon and wind-from SW sector are separate descriptive quantities; no source attribution.

crosscorr.lag_definition: corr(source(t-k), destination(t)); positive k = source leads

pair_selection.rule: Nearest other receptor and corridor within 150 km per receptor; nearest source per source region and receptor; distance then ID; no pollution ranking.

crosscorr.interpretation: Regional pairs provide network context; a ±12h correlation peak is not a validated transport time or an emissions attribution.

spatial_similarity.scope: training rows only, quality flags excluded; exact hourly timestamp alignment
spatial_similarity.interpretation: Distinct series do not establish independent ground observations or independent model errors.
